title: SPEKTRAN: an open simulation engine, data standard, and ML benchmark for TDLAS
description: Open-source simulation engine, data standard, and ML benchmark for optical gas sensing (TDLAS + NDIR). v0.5.0: Hartmann-Tran line profile via hapi, WMS 2f/1f ratio, laser RIN and electronic bandwidth, multi-species (T8) and temperature regression (T9) benchmarks, isotopologue handling, sim-to-real validation. 10 target molecules, 9 benchmark tasks (T1-T9), 10 ML baselines. Built on hapi (HITRAN API) for spectroscopic physics.
notes: Code is Apache-2.0; generated datasets and the data schema are CC BY 4.0. Dataset archives deposited separately with their own DOI at each major release.
